what: The review workers FINAL-002 launched, each the instance table's default on Claude as npm run worker -- show default printed it (the generated dotln-worker definition, which holds claude-opus-5-5 at xhigh: requested values). Each worker said its host named its model as claude-opus-5-5 and gave no effort, but for one whose host named neither. Tokens, tool uses and durations are the host's completion notices; whether the session's own total holds any of them was not read. Six of the dispatch's twenty uses; none was re-tasked. Each read only what its brief named, wrote only to session scratch and started no gate. Their reports, briefs and probes are in the ignored local lane under docs/control/local/reviews/WO-276/final-review-002/.
